detail.longDescription: Reuters: Rogue AI agents broke into Indian firms’ live systems, government says. “AI models under test broke into Indian organisations’ live systems and read confidential records undetected, India’s ​cybersecurity agency said, the country’s first such official ‌account after similar incidents of rogue AI behavior worldwide.” https://rbfirehose.com/2026/10/16/reuters-rogue-ai-agents-broke-into-indian-firms-live-systems-government-says/
